candidateAudit.text: Yesterday, Vienna City Hall became the setting for the 18th Diversity Ball—and what a beautiful celebration it was. People with different backgrounds, identities, experiences and ways of moving, communicating and experiencing music came together to celebrate. I especially appreciated that people with disabilities were present not only among the guests, but also as artists, performers and active participants throughout the evening. Inclusion felt like part of the event’s foundation—not an afterthought. That commitment could be felt in the many accessibility measures: Austrian Sign Language interpretation, accessible facilities, trained assistance, vibration vests through which music could be experienced physically, a Silent Disco and the Dunkelbar hosted by the Austrian Association Supporting the Blind and Visually Impaired. This is what meaningful inclusion looks like: creating a space in which people are considered from the beginning and can participate in ways that work for them. The evening was colourful, joyful and full of energy, but it also carried an important message. Diversity itself is not a barrier. Barriers arise when people and their needs are excluded—and we become stronger when we actively remove them. Thank you, diversityball , for creating a night where diversity was not only celebrated, but genuinely represented and lived. 💗 #diversityball #ViennaEvents #Inclusion #viennaball #wienliebe

candidateAudit.text: „Noch fünf Tage: ein Winter am Schreibtisch" Auf den Sommer im Sattel folgte der Winter am Schreibtisch. Aus Notizen, Kilometerangaben und ziemlich vielen Fotos wurden Texte. Dann kam der Lektor, und mit ihm die Runden, in denen um jeden Punkt und jeden Beistrich gerungen wird. Ein Satz, der beim Schreiben schön geklungen hat, muss am Ende doch weichen, weil er die Abzweigung nicht klar genug erklärt. Im Frühjahr die Fotos: ausgewählt, positioniert, wieder getauscht. Manches Bild hat mehrere Runden gebraucht, bis es dort war, wo es hingehört. Im Sommer war das Buch schließlich druckreif. Und dann kommt der seltsamste Moment am ganzen Vorgang: Man gibt es aus der Hand und wartet. Am Freitag ist das Warten vorbei. ______ Five days to go. After the summer in the saddle came the winter at the desk. Notes, distances, and rather a lot of photographs turned into text. Then came the editor, and with him the rounds where every full stop and comma is fought over. A sentence that sounded lovely while writing has to go in the end, because it doesn't explain the turning clearly enough. In spring, the photographs: chosen, placed, swapped out again. Some needed several rounds before they ended up where they belonged. By summer, the book was ready for print. And then comes the strangest moment of the whole process: you hand it over, and you wait. candidateAudit.text: When I worked at an investment firm, I knew how to build wealth. But I still had to ask permission to take time off to actually enjoy my money. Choose the slow morning. Choose the holiday. Choose to visit family. Choose your clients. Choose to finish at 2pm without your income suffering. I’ve also done the 10–18 hour days glued to my laptop. And yes, you can build a business that makes money that way… But if your business is wealthy and you’re personally poor, exhausted and scared to stop working… what’s the point? candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Vienna Series - Das Schöneberg Vienna’s third district. A 15-minute walk from Belvedere Palace, but a world away from the crowds there. They’re known for their cheese toasties. I somehow missed them this trip, which just means I have a reason to come back. What I did notice was everything else: the home-baked goods lined up under glass, tiny coffee plants growing on a shelf above the counter, and a wall by the bathroom covered in old photos and community flyers. The kind of small details that tell you people actually care about this place. There’s cosy seating inside and a lovely terrace outside, my personal favourite when the weather allows it. candidateAudit.text: Settembre è iniziato ufficialmente! È passata una settimana dalla nostra prima assemblea soci e dall’elezione del nostro consiglio direttivo. candidateAudit.text: 🍋 From a family farm in Sicily to a cocktail glass in Vienna. Some ingredients are bought, others are brought home.
